search_text: published ZDI-22-1156 ZDI-CAN-17255 (Pwn2Own) Softing Secure Integration Server UnZipFolder Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2022-08-23 CVE-2022-1373 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-1373 7.2 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Softing'] ['Secure Integration Server'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Softing Secure Integration Server. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the Zip::UnZipFolder method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Softing has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: (Pwn2Own) Softing Secure Integration Server UnZipFolder Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Softing Secure Integration Server. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the Zip::UnZipFolder method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
